title: Angkor Empire Marathon 2026 Review: 11th Edition at Angkor Wat's Gates
seo_title: Angkor Empire Marathon 2026 Review | Siem Reap Cambodia
meta_description: The 11th Angkor Empire Marathon 2026: August 2 starting in front of Angkor Wat, Siem Reap. Full and half marathon at Cambodia's most iconic temple complex.
dek: Set for 2 August 2026 starting in front of Angkor Wat Temple in Siem Reap, this Cambodia Events-organised marathon reaches its 11th edition. Full and half marathon distances. Registration pending.
verdict: The 11th Angkor Empire Marathon starts at one of the most iconic locations in road racing: directly in front of Angkor Wat. Organised by Cambodia Events — the team behind the Sihanoukville International Half Marathon — this is the sister event to the Angkor Wat International Half Marathon, offering a full marathon distance through the temple complex. August in Siem Reap is the wet season — expect humid, potentially rainy conditions. Registration isn't open yet. For runners wanting a full marathon through Angkor's temple landscape, this is the distance option the half marathon doesn't offer.

sections.heading: Angkor Wat Start Line
paragraphs: Starting directly in front of Angkor Wat — the world's largest religious monument — gives this race an unmatched sense of occasion. [1] Now in its 11th edition, the race is organised by Cambodia Events with a proven track record in Cambodian road racing. The full marathon distance takes runners deeper into the Angkor Archaeological Park than the half.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A full marathon through Angkor's temple complex with an Angkor Wat start line. 2 August 2026 in Siem Reap. [1]
